title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's figure flickered past in the twilight, yet her warning exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder—the depths of the secret realm held something that was watching him.

text.content:
Night colored the world like ink, the bonfire at the trial grounds crackling and casting Chen Ji's silent profile in flickering light. His fingers unconsciously rubbed against the jade slip hidden in his sleeve, a faint smile tugging at his lips—the grin of a hunter spotting prey.

Li Hao's 'casual' leak of information had pointed directly to the entrance of the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji had turned this intelligence over in his mind three times, and each time it tasted the same: deliberate.

Too deliberate.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! What are you doing hiding here?

text.content:
Han Lie's voice came from behind, thundering in his ears. Chen Ji slowly turned, his face already wearing that signature timid expression, eyes slightly reddened as if he'd suffered some great injustice.

Han-shixiong... I-I just got lost just now, I was looking for the way back...

dialogue.content: Trash is trash, can't even find your way!

text.content:
Han Lie sneered, arms crossed as he looked down at Chen Ji, his gaze like observing an ant on the roadside. He was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, merely twenty years old yet already at the peak of Condensation Liquid realm, his combat power足以碾压同阶三人 enough to crush three peers.

Chen Ji kept his head bowed, shoulders trembling slightly—if Han Lie could have seen his expression, he would have noticed that trembling was clearly from suppressing laughter.

dialogue.content: Han-shixiong's lesson is well taken... By the way, I think I heard Brother Li saying he was taking people to the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds? Isn't that place very dangerous?

text.content:
Chen Ji lifted his face, eyes full of 'sincere concern'. Han Lie's pupils slightly contracted before he feigned nonchalance with a cold snort.

Hmph, that Li Hao kid sure has guts.

Han Lie turned and left, his pace even more hurried than when he'd arrived. Chen Ji watched his departing back, a smile finally spreading from his lips—the bait had been cast, now to see who would bite first.

choice.prompt: The false intelligence has been released. How do we draw in the net?

choices.description: Personally confirm every step of the intelligence transfer, ensuring the Demonic Path contact takes the bait

text.content: Chen Ji moved silently after Li Hao, his form pressed against the shadows of the rock walls, like a venomous snake merging with darkness. His breathing was terrifyingly steady, his heartbeat no more than once per breath—the 'Stealth Breathing Technique' recorded in the Tianji Record, undetectable even by a Condensation Liquid realm's spiritual sense.

choices.description: Return to camp to await the Demonic Path's reaction, resting while waiting for action

text.content: Chen Ji didn't move, merely finding a clean rock to sit on, taking out a dry ration from his sleeve to slowly chew. His gaze seemed unfocused, yet in reality he had everything within a hundred zhang under observation. Why rush? The fish will swim into the net on its own.

About half a stick of incense later, a black figure raced back from the direction where Li Hao had disappeared. Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly—that stance, that aura, was unmistakably the Demonic Path's unique 'Shadowstep'.

Here they come.

He silently merged into deeper shadows, fingertips already quietly pinching three silent poison needles. If anything went wrong tonight, these three needles would be the death sentence for Li Hao and that Demonic Path contact.

The black figure stopped behind an ancient pine thirty zhang away, seemingly confirming something. Chen Ji held his breath, yet heard the man mutter:

Li Hao says there's a Tianji Record inheritor at the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds... Hmph, such a trivial matter that the Saintess personally inquires about?

Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted. Saintess? Ye Qing?

choice.prompt: Unexpectedly hearing Ye Qing's name—how to respond?

choices.text: Reveal oneself and confront the Demonic Path member
choices.description: Directly reveal your identity, demanding the other explain Ye Qing's involvement
choices.risk_hint: The other party might be an enemy

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to take that step, an icy finger suddenly pressed against his lips from behind. A familiar ethereal fragrance entered his nostrils—Xuetang flower, unique to Ye Qing. His body went rigid, a low female voice reached his ear: "Don't move, that person is a scout from the Holy Sect."

choices.description: Wait for Ye Qing to make contact proactively, clarify her intentions before deciding
choices.risk_hint: Might miss chance to contact Ye Qing

text.content: Chen Ji remained motionless, continuing to lie in ambush. The Demonic Path scout muttered a few words before vanishing into the night. Just as he relaxed, a light laugh rang out from the darkness behind him: "Brother Chen, your acting skills are impressive." That voice was cold as frost, yet carried a hint of mockery.

Ye Qing stepped out from the shadows, her black combat attire outlining her tall, graceful form, cold and striking in every feature. Her gaze swept over Chen Ji, then she suddenly laughed:

Interesting. You deliberately leaked false intelligence to lure the Demonic Path people to the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds... are you setting a counter-trap, or trying to drag me into it too?

Chen Ji's heart missed a beat, but his expression remained perfectly still.

dialogue.content: Stop pretending, Brother Chen. Your little tricks can fool idiots like Li Hao, but not me.

text.content:
Ye Qing stepped closer, moonlight falling on her profile, illuminating that ambiguous smile. Her voice dropped extremely low, carrying a warning:

But I must remind you of something—something in the depths of the secret realm is watching you. That feeling... I've experienced it before too.

dialogue.content: I don't know. But when the elders of the Holy Sect mention that area, they never dare speak its name directly. They only say something 'that should not be awakened' sleeps there.

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent.

Something that should not be awakened...

He unconsciously reached into his sleeve with his right hand, fingertips touching that warm fragment. The Tianji Record suddenly trembled slightly, as if responding to something. This feeling was familiar—every time a major crisis approached, the Tianji Record would give this warning.

Only this time, that tremor seemed mixed with a hint of... fear?

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record is reacting abnormally—how to respond?

choices.text: Press Ye Qing for more details
choices.description: Utilize this rare exchange opportunity to extract as much information about the secret realm as possible
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might use this to make demands

dialogue.content: Lady Ye seems quite knowledgeable about that 'thing that should not be awakened'? Might I trouble you for instruction?

choices.description: Don't expose your desire for intelligence, observe Ye Qing's true purpose

dialogue.content: Chen Ji merely smiled faintly: "Lady Ye specifically came here, surely not just to warn me?"

text.content:
Ye Qing's eyes flickered, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's composure. She huffed lightly but didn't press further, instead taking a jet-black token from her sleeve and tossing it to Chen Ji.

This is the Holy Sect's 'Shadow Token'. If you encounter danger in the secret realm you cannot resolve, crush it and I will come immediately.

Chen Ji caught the token, its touch ice-cold. He looked up at Ye Qing, her cold, beautiful face revealing no trace of emotion under the moonlight.

dialogue.content: Don't misunderstand, I'm not helping you. I simply don't want the Tianji Record to fall into the hands of those old monsters at the Holy Sect.

text.content:
With that, her figure silently merged back into the night as she'd come. Chen Ji gripped the token, his knuckles slightly white.

The Tianji Record trembled again lightly.

He closed his eyes, diving his consciousness into that fragment. A moment later, his brow tightly furrowed—the foresight vision shown by the Tianji Record depicted that blurry figure standing deep within the secret realm slowly turning its head, seemingly... looking directly at him.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a layer of fine cold sweat beading at his temples. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record ghostly spoke: "You see it now? That is the thing that has been watching you."

"What is it?" Chen Ji asked in his heart.

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long time before finally uttering four difficult words:

"The Heavenly... Dao's Eye."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that final BOSS which wouldn't appear until Volume 8, was actually already watching him?

Night wind swept past, carrying the commotion from the trial grounds. Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Shadow Token into his sleeve, his expression regaining calm.

Whatever awaited ahead, he would not retreat.

Li Hao's false intelligence had been successfully delivered, the Demonic Path scouts had taken the bait. Next, it was time to see who would first step into the chess game he had arranged.

Chen Ji raised his head toward the secret realm, a sharp light flickering in his eyes: Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye was watching him, he would let these eyes see clearly—how atrash弟子 would throw the world's chess game into chaos.
